title: narcissus radiiflorus subsp. poetarum
intro: Narcissus radiiflorus subsp. poetarum, commonly known as the poet's narcissus or spring flowering daffodil, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties. By utilizing the poet's narcissus in a controlled and regulated manner, individuals may experience relief from various health issues while also promoting overall well-being.
